title: Sweetango Orchard Sour
headnote: A bright, apple-forward bourbon sour designed around Fowler Farms Sweetango pure apple cider. Michter’s Small Batch adds gentle vanilla and caramel notes without overpowering the fresh sweet-tart cider. No mulled spices or added syrup.

items: 75 ml Fowler Farms Sweetango pure apple cider

steps: Add the bourbon, Sweetango cider, elderflower liqueur and fresh lemon juice to a cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe. Garnish with a thin apple slice if desired.
reviewFlags: Draft — recipe has not yet been mixed and taste-tested; adjust lemon or elderflower after tasting.
sourceNote: Developed in conversation for Fowler Farms Sweetango cider, using Michter’s Small Batch Bourbon. Intended to preserve the cider’s bright, sweet-tart character without mulled spices.
